```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library (ggplot2)
```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean%>% select(SEQN,DPQ020, DIQ010, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3)
```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  select(SEQN, DPQ020, DIQ010, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3) %>%
  mutate(
    diabetes = case_when(
      DIQ010 == 1 ~ 1,    
      DIQ010 == 2 ~ 0,              
      DIQ010 %in% c(3, 7, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_               
    ),
    diabetes_f = factor(
      diabetes,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )

```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    depress01 = case_when(
      DPQ020 == 0 ~ 0,          
      DPQ020 %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1,        
      TRUE ~ NA_real_                  
    ),
    depress_f = factor(
      depress01,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No depression", "Depression")
    )
  )

```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    gender = case_when(
      RIAGENDR == 1 ~ "Male",
      RIAGENDR == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    race3 = case_when(
      RIDRETH3 == 3 ~ "White",
      RIDRETH3 == 4 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    race3 = factor(race3, levels = c("White", "Black", "Other"))
  )

```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(RIDAGEYR)
  )

`
```
```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    depress01 = case_when(
      DPQ020 == 0 ~ 0,
      DPQ020 %in% c(1,2,3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    depress_f = factor(depress01,
                       levels = c(0,1),
                       labels = c("No depression","Depression"))
  )

```



```{r}

ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>% drop_na(depress01, diabetes, age, gender, race3)
```
```{r}
model_dep_diab <- glm(
  diabetes ~ depress01,
  data = ADA_clean,
  family = binomial
)

```
```{r}
summary(model_dep_diab)

```
```{r}
exp(coef(model_dep_diab))

```
```{r}
exp(confint(model_dep_diab))

```
```{r}
exp(confint.default(model_dep_diab))

```
```{r}
model_adj <- glm(
  diabetes ~ depress01 + age + gender + race3,
  data = ADA_clean,
  family = binomial
)

```
```{r}
summary(model_dep_diab)

```
```{r}
exp(0.14635)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ADA_clean %>%
  group_by(depress_f, diabetes_f) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = depress_f, y = n, fill = diabetes_f)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Depression Status", y = "Proportion", fill = "Diabetes",
       title = "Proportion of Diabetes by Depression Status") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
ggplot(ADA_clean, aes(x = depress_f, fill = diabetes_f)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Depression Status", y = "Count",
       title = "Counts of Diabetes by Depression Status") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
library(broom)

model_dep_diab %>%
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = term, y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Odds Ratio for Diabetes by Depression Status",
       x = "Predictor", y = "Odds Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)    
library(broom)    
library(knitr)    

```
```{r}
model2 <- glm(diabetes ~ depress01 + age + gender + race3,
              data = ADA_clean,
              family = binomial)
```
```{r}
results_table <- model2 %>%
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    OR = round(estimate, 2),
    CI = paste0("(", round(conf.low, 2), ", ", round(conf.high, 2), ")"),
    p_value = round(p.value, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(term, OR, CI, p_value)
```
```{r}
knitr::kable(
  results_table,
  caption = "Odds Ratios, 95% Confidence Intervals, and p-values"
)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- ADA_clean %>%
  group_by(depress_f) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_diab = mean(diabetes == 1, na.rm = TRUE)  # proportion with diabetes
  )

plot_data

```
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = depress_f, y = prop_diab)) +
  geom_col() +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Depressive symptoms",
    y = "Proportion with diabetes",
    title = "Proportion of participants with diabetes by depression status"
  )

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- ADA_clean %>%
  group_by(depress_f) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct_diab = 100 * mean(diabetes == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
plot_data

```
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = depress_f, y = pct_diab, fill = depress_f)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_diab, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(plot_data$pct_diab) * 1.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Depressive symptoms",
    y = "Percent with diabetes",
    title = "Percent of participants with diabetes by depression status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r}
ADA_clean <- ADA_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age < 40 ~ "<40",
      age >= 40 & age < 60 ~ "40–59",
      age >= 60 ~ "60+"
    ),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<40","40–59","60+"))
  )

```
```{r}
ggplot(ADA_clean, aes(x = depress_f, fill = diabetes_f)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group) +
  labs(
    title = "Diabetes by Depression Status Across Age Groups",
    x = "Depression status",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Diabetes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```
